fieldKitImpact.name: Brush
fieldKitImpact.collectedDesc: Your team is equipped with precision brushes, allowing for the safe recovery of fragile mudbrick and ceramics.
fieldKitImpact.missingDesc: Without precision brushes, fragile surface details may be lost during the excavation process.

fieldKitImpact.name: Trowel
fieldKitImpact.collectedDesc: The masonry trowel is essential for defining the edges of stone foundations and mudbrick walls.
fieldKitImpact.missingDesc: Lack of proper trowels will make it difficult to distinguish built features from surrounding debris.

fieldKitImpact.name: Notebook
fieldKitImpact.collectedDesc: Standard Bureau notebooks are ready for recording every layer and context found during the dig.
fieldKitImpact.missingDesc: Without notebooks, your team will rely on memory, leading to less detailed final reports.

fieldKitImpact.name: Camera
fieldKitImpact.collectedDesc: The survey camera allows for high-resolution documentation of evidence in its original context.
fieldKitImpact.missingDesc: Moving evidence without photographs significantly reduces its historical value and quality.

fieldKitImpact.name: Measuring Tape
fieldKitImpact.collectedDesc: Steel measuring tapes allow for the precise recording of artifact coordinates within the grid.
fieldKitImpact.missingDesc: Estimated measurements will result in a less accurate map of the site layout.

fieldKitImpact.name: Field Guide Page
fieldKitImpact.collectedDesc: The field guide provides instant reference for identifying Egyptian pottery and architectural styles.
fieldKitImpact.missingDesc: Identifying unfamiliar artifacts will be much slower and more prone to error.
